nodes.label: Diffusivities from tortuosities
nodes.description:
Diffusivities from tortuosities
Owner organization: FZJ IET 3
Task: T1.4
Maturity: established method
Documentation: Relies on well-known (binary, or effective Fick) diffusion coefficients for the gas composition of interest, and the analytical expression:D_eff = D_free * porosity/tortuosity
Range of validity or processability: 
If we think of "tortuosity" to be defined according to this method, it is valid by definition.Some care needed to avoid inconsistent usage (regarding channel-land effects, merging layer properties, gas composition, neglect of Knudsen or other effects such as Pt-near contributions)
internal key: Diffusivities from tortuosities0

nodes.label: MPL parameter estimation from GDL and substrate data
nodes.description:
MPL parameter estimation from GDL and substrate data
Owner organization: Bosch
Task: T2.1
Maturity: established method
Documentation: following simple formulas are used:MPL thickness estimation: L_MPL = L_GDL - L_sub.MPL conductivity estimation: sigma_MPL = L_MPL / ( L_GDL/sigma_TP,GDL - L_sub/sigma_TP,sub).MPL permeability estimation: kappa_MPL = L_MPL / ( L_GDL/kappa_TP,GDL - L_sub/kappa_TP,sub).Correction of in-plane permeability in substrate (due to partial MPL intrusion): kappa_IP,sub = (kappa_IP,GDL*L_GDL - kappa_MPL*L_MPL)/L_sub.MPL porosity estimation: eps_MPL = (L_GDL*eps_GDL - L_sub*eps_sub)/L_MPL.Estimation of average pore radius': Through visual inspection of GDL and substrate pore size distributions, identifying the MPL contribution as main difference between the two, and possibly using the large-pore region from the GDL data for refining the substrate pore radius.
Range of validity or processability: 
Accuracy/validity depends strongly on the specific material, and especially on the extent to which MPL material intrudes into the substrate. Results should be validated against other methods (i.e. property estimations based on tomography data)
internal key: MPL parameter estimation from GDL and substrate data0
